note: 种子题库。题目按 NVIDIA 官方考试大纲（public blueprint）生成，用于内网学习自测，可随时扩充。

exams.name: NCA-AIIO
exams.nameZh: NVIDIA 认证助理：AI 基础设施与运维

questions.q: What is CUDA?
questions.qZh: CUDA 是什么？
o: NVIDIA's parallel computing platform and programming model
A network protocol for GPU clusters
oZh: NVIDIA 的并行计算平台与编程模型
questions.e: CUDA is the foundational parallel computing platform and programming model on which the NVIDIA AI software stack is built.
questions.eZh: CUDA 是 NVIDIA AI 软件栈的底层并行计算平台与编程模型。

questions.q: What is the role of cuDNN?
questions.qZh: cuDNN 的作用是什么？
o: A library of GPU-accelerated primitives for deep learning frameworks
A storage system for training data
oZh: 为深度学习框架提供 GPU 加速的基础运算原语
questions.e: cuDNN provides highly tuned primitives (convolutions, pooling, etc.) that deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow call on GPUs.
questions.eZh: cuDNN 提供高度优化的卷积、池化等原语，PyTorch、TensorFlow 等框架在 GPU 上直接调用。

questions.q: What does TensorRT do?
questions.qZh: TensorRT 的作用是什么？
o: Optimizes trained models for high-performance inference
oZh: 对训练好的模型做优化以实现高性能推理
questions.e: TensorRT takes a trained network and optimizes it (layer fusion, precision calibration, kernels) into an inference engine.
questions.eZh: TensorRT 对训练好的网络做算子融合、精度校准、内核优化，生成高性能推理引擎。

questions.q: Which product serves trained models in production regardless of framework?
questions.qZh: 哪个产品可以跨框架地在生产环境中部署（服务）训练好的模型？
questions.e: Triton Inference Server serves models from TensorFlow, PyTorch, TensorRT, ONNX and other backends behind a single API.
questions.eZh: Triton 推理服务器通过统一 API 服务 TensorFlow、PyTorch、TensorRT、ONNX 等多种后端模型。

questions.q: What is RAPIDS?
questions.qZh: RAPIDS 是什么？
o: A suite of GPU-accelerated data science libraries (e.g. cuDF, cuML)
oZh: 一套 GPU 加速的数据科学库（如 cuDF、cuML）
questions.e: RAPIDS brings pandas-like and scikit-learn-like workflows to GPUs via cuDF, cuML and related libraries.
questions.eZh: RAPIDS 通过 cuDF、cuML 等库把 pandas、scikit-learn 风格的数据科学工作流搬到 GPU 上。

questions.q: NeMo is best described as:
questions.qZh: NeMo 最准确的描述是：
o: A framework for building and fine-tuning generative AI models
oZh: 用于构建和微调生成式 AI 模型的框架
questions.e: NeMo is NVIDIA's framework for training and fine-tuning LLMs, multimodal and speech models.
questions.eZh: NeMo 是 NVIDIA 用于训练和微调大语言模型、多模态与语音模型的框架。

questions.q: What are NVIDIA NIM microservices?
questions.qZh: NVIDIA NIM 微服务是什么？
o: Optimized inference microservices packaged for standardized deployment
Micro partitions of a GPU provided by MIG
oZh: 打包成标准化部署形式的优化推理微服务
用于 DPU 安全的网络微分段
MIG 提供的 GPU 微型分区
questions.e: NIM packages optimized inference engines (TensorRT-LLM etc.) as containerized microservices with standard APIs.
questions.eZh: NIM 把优化好的推理引擎（如 TensorRT-LLM）打包成带标准 API 的容器化微服务。

questions.q: Which hardware characteristic matters most for large-model distributed training?
questions.qZh: 对大模型分布式训练而言，哪项硬件特性最关键？
o: Many tightly coupled GPUs with high interconnect bandwidth
oZh: 大量紧耦合、互连带宽高的 GPU
questions.e: Distributed training synchronizes gradients across GPUs constantly, so GPU count and inter-GPU/inter-node bandwidth dominate performance.
questions.eZh: 分布式训练需要 GPU 之间持续同步梯度，因此 GPU 数量和互连带宽是性能决定因素。

questions.q: Supervised learning is characterized by:
questions.qZh: 监督学习的特点是：
o: Learning from rewards in an environment
oZh: 从带标签的数据中学习
在无标签数据中发现结构
questions.e: In supervised learning the model learns a mapping from inputs to known labels (classification, regression).
questions.eZh: 监督学习让模型学习输入到已知标签的映射，如分类和回归任务。

questions.q: Clustering a dataset without labels is an example of:
questions.qZh: 对无标签数据集做聚类属于：
questions.e: Unsupervised learning finds structure (clusters, latent factors) in unlabeled data.
questions.eZh: 无监督学习在没有标签的数据中挖掘结构，例如聚类和降维。

questions.q: In reinforcement learning, the model learns:
questions.qZh: 强化学习中，模型通过什么学习？
o: Through actions and rewards from an environment
oZh: 通过与环境交互获得动作和奖励
直接复制另一个模型的权重
questions.e: An agent takes actions in an environment and learns a policy that maximizes cumulative reward.
questions.eZh: 智能体在环境中执行动作，通过最大化累计奖励来学习最优策略。

questions.q: How do GPU and CPU architectures fundamentally differ?
questions.qZh: GPU 与 CPU 的架构本质区别是什么？
o: GPUs have thousands of simple cores optimized for parallel throughput; CPUs have few powerful cores for serial code
GPUs only run graphics; CPUs run AI
CPUs have more memory bandwidth than GPUs
oZh: GPU 拥有数千个面向并行吞吐的简单核心，CPU 只有少量复杂核心适合串行逻辑
GPU 只能跑图形，CPU 才能跑 AI
CPU 的内存带宽比 GPU 高
questions.e: GPUs trade per-core complexity for massive parallelism; CPUs keep few complex cores with big caches and branch prediction.
questions.eZh: GPU 用大量简单核心换取并行吞吐；CPU 用少量复杂核心（大缓存、分支预测）处理串行逻辑。

questions.q: What do Tensor Cores do?
questions.qZh: Tensor Core 的作用是什么？
o: Accelerate matrix multiply-accumulate operations in mixed precision
oZh: 以混合精度加速矩阵乘加运算
questions.e: Tensor Cores are dedicated hardware units that accelerate matrix operations in FP16/BF16/FP8/FP4 precision, the core compute of AI.
questions.eZh: Tensor Core 是专用硬件单元，以 FP16/BF16/FP8/FP4 精度加速矩阵运算，是 AI 计算的核心。

questions.q: The main benefit of mixed-precision training is:
questions.qZh: 混合精度训练的主要好处是：
o: Faster training and lower memory use with minimal accuracy loss
It removes the need for GPUs
oZh: 训练更快、显存占用更低，精度损失可忽略
questions.e: Using FP16/BF16 for most math (with FP32 master weights) speeds up Tensor Core compute and halves memory traffic.
questions.eZh: 大部分计算用 FP16/BF16（配合 FP32 主权重），可加速 Tensor Core 计算并大幅降低显存占用。

questions.q: Which mechanism is central to the Transformer architecture?
questions.qZh: Transformer 架构的核心机制是什么？
questions.e: Self-attention lets every token weigh its relationship to every other token and parallelizes far better than recurrence.
questions.eZh: 自注意力让每个 token 都能衡量与其他 token 的关系，且远比循环结构易于并行。

questions.q: Compared to traditional machine learning, deep learning:
questions.qZh: 与传统机器学习相比，深度学习：
o: Automatically learns feature representations from raw data
oZh: 自动从原始数据中学习特征表示
不能在 GPU 上运行
questions.e: Deep neural networks learn hierarchical features end-to-end, removing much of the manual feature engineering.
questions.eZh: 深度神经网络端到端地学习层级特征，大幅减少人工特征工程。

questions.q: How does fine-tuning differ from prompt engineering?
questions.qZh: 微调（fine-tuning）与提示工程（prompt engineering）的区别是？
o: Fine-tuning updates model weights; prompting does not
Fine-tuning only works on small models
oZh: 微调会更新模型权重，提示工程不会
questions.e: Fine-tuning continues training on task data to change weights; prompt engineering only conditions the frozen model at inference time.
questions.eZh: 微调在任务数据上继续训练从而改变权重；提示工程只是在使用时引导冻结的模型。

questions.q: LLM inference is often limited by:
questions.qZh: 大模型推理（LLM inference）通常受限于：
questions.e: Autoregressive decoding streams model weights for each token, making HBM bandwidth a primary bottleneck.
questions.eZh: 自回归解码时每个 token 都要搬运模型权重，HBM 显存带宽往往成为首要瓶颈。

questions.q: What is the effect of quantization (e.g. INT8/FP8/FP4) on inference?
questions.qZh: 量化（如 INT8/FP8/FP4）对推理的影响是什么？
o: Lower memory use and faster inference with a small accuracy risk
oZh: 显存更省、推理更快，精度损失风险较小
questions.e: Quantized weights and activations shrink memory traffic and allow faster low-precision kernels, trading a small accuracy risk.
questions.eZh: 量化后权重和激活更省显存、可用低精度算子加速，代价是可能带来少量精度损失。

questions.q: What is NGC (NVIDIA GPU Cloud)?
questions.qZh: NGC（NVIDIA GPU Cloud）是什么？
o: A catalog of GPU-optimized containers, pretrained models and SDKs
oZh: GPU 优化容器、预训练模型和 SDK 的目录/仓库
questions.e: NGC hosts validated, GPU-optimized software containers and models that run across on-prem and cloud environments.
questions.eZh: NGC 提供经过验证的 GPU 优化容器与模型，可在本地和云端环境一致运行。

questions.q: Which layer is the foundation of the NVIDIA AI software stack?
questions.qZh: NVIDIA AI 软件栈的最底层基础是：
questions.e: Libraries like cuDNN, TensorRT and RAPIDS all build on the CUDA platform.
questions.eZh: cuDNN、TensorRT、RAPIDS 等库都构建在 CUDA 平台之上。

questions.q: What is the relationship between TensorRT and Triton?
questions.qZh: TensorRT 与 Triton 的关系是？
o: TensorRT optimizes a model into an engine; Triton serves models in production
They compete as two serving servers
Triton compiles models; TensorRT serves them
oZh: TensorRT 把模型优化成引擎，Triton 在生产环境提供服务
两者是相互竞争的推理服务器
Triton 编译模型，TensorRT 做服务
questions.e: TensorRT is an inference optimizer/runtime; Triton is a serving layer that can host TensorRT engines among other backends.
questions.eZh: TensorRT 是推理优化器和运行时；Triton 是服务层，可承载 TensorRT 引擎等多种后端。

questions.q: A model that jointly processes text and images is called:
questions.qZh: 能同时处理文本和图像的模型称为：
questions.e: Multimodal models learn across modalities such as text, image and audio.
questions.eZh: 多模态模型能跨文本、图像、音频等模态联合学习。

questions.q: What is NVLink?
questions.qZh: NVLink 是什么？
oZh: NVIDIA 的高带宽 GPU 直连互连技术
questions.e: NVLink provides point-to-point GPU interconnect bandwidth far beyond PCIe, enabling fast multi-GPU communication.
questions.eZh: NVLink 提供远超 PCIe 的点对点 GPU 互连带宽，支撑多 GPU 高速通信。

questions.q: What does NVSwitch add inside a DGX/HGX node?
questions.qZh: NVSwitch 在 DGX/HGX 节点内的作用是？
o: Full-bandwidth all-to-all connectivity among all GPUs
oZh: 让节点内所有 GPU 之间实现全带宽全互联
questions.e: NVSwitch lets every GPU talk to every other GPU at NVLink speed, so a node behaves like one large GPU pool.
questions.eZh: NVSwitch 让任意两块 GPU 都能以 NVLink 速度互访，节点如同一个整体 GPU 池。

questions.q: Why is InfiniBand commonly chosen for multi-node AI training clusters?
questions.qZh: 多节点 AI 训练集群为什么常选 InfiniBand？
o: Low-latency RDMA networking that speeds gradient synchronization
It is cheaper than any Ethernet switch
It replaces the need for GPUs
oZh: 低延迟 RDMA 网络可加速梯度同步
比任何以太网交换机都便宜
questions.e: InfiniBand offers low latency, high throughput and RDMA, reducing time lost to allreduce and other collectives.
questions.eZh: InfiniBand 提供低延迟、高吞吐和 RDMA，显著减少 allreduce 等集合通信的等待时间。

questions.q: What is RoCE?
questions.qZh: RoCE 是什么？
oZh: 基于融合以太网的 RDMA
一种 GPU 散热方式
questions.e: RoCE delivers RDMA semantics over standard Ethernet, an alternative fabric to InfiniBand for AI clusters.
questions.eZh: RoCE 在标准以太网上实现 RDMA 语义，是 AI 集群里 InfiniBand 的以太网替代方案。

questions.q: What is the primary benefit of a BlueField DPU in an AI data center?
questions.qZh: BlueField DPU 在 AI 数据中心的主要价值是？
o: Offloading networking, storage and security tasks from host CPUs
oZh: 把网络、存储和安全任务从主机 CPU 卸载
questions.e: A DPU offloads infrastructure services to dedicated silicon, freeing host CPUs for application work and improving isolation.
questions.eZh: DPU 用专用芯片承担基础设施服务，释放主机 CPU 给业务负载，并提升隔离性。

questions.q: What best describes an NVIDIA DGX system?
questions.qZh: 对 NVIDIA DGX 系统最准确的描述是：
o: An integrated AI system with GPUs, interconnect and software, ready to run
oZh: 集成 GPU、互连与软件、开箱即用的整体 AI 系统
仅含 GPU 的裸基板
questions.e: DGX is NVIDIA's turnkey AI supercomputer: servers, networking, and the full software stack integrated and supported.
questions.eZh: DGX 是 NVIDIA 的交钥匙 AI 超算：服务器、网络与完整软件栈集成交付并提供支持。

questions.q: How do HGX and DGX differ?
questions.qZh: HGX 与 DGX 的区别是？
o: HGX is a GPU baseboard that OEM partners integrate; DGX is NVIDIA's complete system
HGX is a cloud service; DGX is a GPU
DGX is a baseboard; HGX is a complete system
oZh: HGX 是供 OEM 厂商集成的 GPU 基板，DGX 是 NVIDIA 的完整系统
HGX 是云服务，DGX 是 GPU
DGX 是基板，HGX 是完整系统
questions.e: HGX boards ship to server manufacturers to build their own systems; DGX is NVIDIA's own branded, integrated platform.
questions.eZh: HGX 基板交给服务器厂商自行集成；DGX 是 NVIDIA 自有品牌的一体化平台。

questions.q: Which statement about the Blackwell architecture is correct?
questions.qZh: 关于 Blackwell 架构，下列哪项正确？
o: It succeeds Hopper and adds low-precision (FP4) support and larger NVLink domains such as GB200 NVL72
oZh: 它是 Hopper 的后继架构，新增 FP4 等低精度支持，并支持 GB200 NVL72 等更大 NVLink 域
questions.e: Blackwell follows Hopper, adds FP4/FP2-precision Tensor Cores, and scales to 72-GPU NVLink domains (GB200 NVL72).
questions.eZh: Blackwell 接替 Hopper，新增 FP4/FP2 精度 Tensor Core，并把 NVLink 域扩展到 72 卡（GB200 NVL72）。

questions.q: What is the key difference between SXM and PCIe GPUs?
questions.qZh: SXM GPU 与 PCIe GPU 的关键区别是？
o: SXM GPUs socket directly to the baseboard with NVLink; PCIe GPUs use slots with limited inter-GPU bandwidth
PCIe GPUs cannot be used for AI
oZh: SXM GPU 直接插在基板上并支持 NVLink；PCIe GPU 用插槽，GPU 间带宽有限
PCIe GPU 不能用于 AI
questions.e: SXM form factor enables dense NVLink topologies; PCIe cards are modular but inter-GPU traffic goes over PCIe.
questions.eZh: SXM 形态支持高密度 NVLink 拓扑；PCIe 卡更灵活但 GPU 间流量要走 PCIe 总线。

questions.q: What is a rail-optimized network design?
questions.qZh: 什么是 rail-optimized（轨道优化）网络设计？
o: Each GPU's NIC connects to a dedicated switch rail so all GPUs get uniform bandwidth
All NICs connect to one switch
Networks are wired in a ring
oZh: 每块 GPU 的网卡分别连到专用交换机轨道，保证所有 GPU 带宽一致
所有网卡连到一台交换机
questions.e: In rail optimization, GPU i connects to rail switch i, giving deterministic, uniform bandwidth for collective patterns.
questions.eZh: 轨道优化中第 i 块 GPU 连到第 i 台轨道交换机，为集合通信提供确定且均匀的带宽。

questions.q: Why do AI clusters use spine-leaf / fat-tree topologies?
questions.qZh: AI 集群为什么采用 spine-leaf / fat-tree 拓扑？
o: To provide predictable, non-blocking east-west bandwidth at scale
Because they require fewer switches and nothing else
oZh: 在大规模下提供可预期的无阻塞东西向带宽
questions.e: Fat-tree style topologies give every-to-every bandwidth so many GPUs can allreduce simultaneously without hotspots.
questions.eZh: fat-tree 类拓扑保证任意节点间带宽，让大量 GPU 同时做 allreduce 而不产生拥塞热点。

questions.q: What does GPUDirect RDMA enable?
questions.qZh: GPUDirect RDMA 实现了什么？
o: A NIC writes data directly into GPU memory without a host CPU bounce buffer
CPUs access GPU memory over the network
oZh: 网卡把数据直接写入 GPU 显存，无需主机 CPU 中转缓冲
CPU 通过网络访问 GPU 显存
GPU 通过 USB 通信
questions.e: GPUDirect RDMA lets a NIC DMA straight to GPU memory, cutting latency and CPU overhead for collectives.
questions.eZh: GPUDirect RDMA 让网卡以 DMA 方式直达显存，降低集合通信的延迟与 CPU 开销。

questions.q: Why do GB200-class rack systems require direct liquid cooling?
questions.qZh: GB200 级机柜系统为什么必须采用直接液冷？
o: Power density exceeds what air cooling can remove
Fans are banned in data centers
oZh: 功率密度超出风冷所能带走的热量
数据中心禁止使用风扇
questions.e: At ~100kW+ per rack, air cooling cannot extract enough heat; direct-to-chip liquid loops become mandatory.
questions.eZh: 单柜功率超过 100kW 时风冷无法带走热量，必须使用芯片级直接液冷回路。

questions.q: When planning an AI data center, rack power density means:
questions.qZh: 在 AI 数据中心规划中，机柜功率密度指的是：
o: Kilowatts per rack, which drives PDU, busway, power and cooling provisioning
oZh: 单机柜的千瓦数，决定 PDU、母线、供电和散热的配置
questions.e: AI racks draw tens of kW or more, far above traditional IT racks, so facility power and cooling must be planned around it.
questions.eZh: AI 机柜功耗达数十千瓦以上，远超传统机柜，设施供电与散热必须围绕功率密度规划。

questions.q: What storage characteristic matters most for training dataloaders?
questions.qZh: 对训练数据加载（dataloader）而言，存储最重要的特性是？
o: High aggregate throughput and many small-read performance (parallel file systems)
oZh: 高聚合吞吐和大量小文件读性能（并行文件系统）
questions.e: GPUs starve if storage cannot feed them; parallel FS like Lustre/GPFS/WEKA provide the needed aggregate bandwidth.
questions.eZh: 存储喂不饱 GPU 就会使其空转；Lustre/GPFS/WEKA 等并行文件系统提供所需的聚合带宽。

questions.q: What is DGX Cloud?
questions.qZh: DGX Cloud 是什么？
o: DGX-class instances hosted by cloud providers with the NVIDIA software stack
oZh: 由云厂商托管、带 NVIDIA 软件栈的 DGX 级实例
免费的公共 GPU 池
questions.e: DGX Cloud rents DGX-class capacity on partner clouds with the same software stack as on-prem DGX.
questions.eZh: DGX Cloud 在合作云上出租 DGX 级算力，软件栈与本地 DGX 一致。

questions.q: Which factor most strongly favors on-premises deployment over cloud?
questions.qZh: 哪一因素最能支持选择本地部署而非云部署？
o: Data control/compliance plus steady, high utilization of the hardware
oZh: 数据管控/合规要求，加上硬件长期高利用率
没有内部 IT 团队
questions.e: Steady workloads amortize on-prem capex and keep sensitive data in-house; bursty or exploratory use favors cloud.
questions.eZh: 长期稳定的负载可摊薄本地建设成本并留住敏感数据；突发或探索性负载更适合云。

questions.q: What is the NVIDIA Grace CPU?
questions.qZh: NVIDIA Grace CPU 是什么？
o: An ARM-based NVIDIA CPU that attaches tightly to GPUs via NVLink-C2C
oZh: 基于 ARM 的 NVIDIA CPU，通过 NVLink-C2C 与 GPU 紧密耦合
老旧的 x86 服务器 CPU
questions.e: Grace pairs with GPUs using NVLink-C2C for coherent memory access at very high bandwidth (e.g. Grace Hopper / Grace Blackwell).
questions.eZh: Grace 通过 NVLink-C2C 与 GPU 实现超高带宽的一致性内存访问（如 Grace Hopper / Grace Blackwell）。

questions.q: What is HBM and why does it matter?
questions.qZh: HBM 是什么，为什么重要？
o: High Bandwidth Memory stacked close to the GPU, feeding data-hungry compute
oZh: 堆叠在 GPU 旁边的高带宽显存，为 hungry 计算供数
questions.e: HBM provides terabytes-per-second bandwidth on the GPU package; without it Tensor Cores would starve.
questions.eZh: HBM 在 GPU 封装内提供每秒 TB 级带宽，否则 Tensor Core 将因供数不足而空转。

questions.q: What does MIG (Multi-Instance GPU) do?
questions.qZh: MIG（多实例 GPU）的作用是？
o: Hardware-partitions one GPU into isolated instances with dedicated SMs and memory
oZh: 在硬件层把一块 GPU 划分成带独立 SM 和显存的隔离实例
把多块 GPU 组成集群
把一块 GPU 镜像到另一块
questions.e: MIG creates up to 7 isolated GPU instances with their own SMs, memory and bandwidth for safe sharing.
questions.eZh: MIG 最多把一块 GPU 分成 7 个拥有独立 SM、显存和带宽的隔离实例，便于安全共享。

questions.q: Besides latency, which InfiniBand feature reduces time spent on collective operations?
questions.qZh: 除低延迟外，InfiniBand 的哪项特性能减少集合通信耗时？
o: SHARP in-network aggregation on the switches
oZh: 交换机上的 SHARP 在网聚合
questions.e: SHARP performs reductions (e.g. allreduce) inside the switch fabric, cutting data each endpoint must send.
questions.eZh: SHARP 在交换网络内部完成归约（如 allreduce），减少每个端点需要发送的数据量。

questions.q: What does GPUDirect Storage do?
questions.qZh: GPUDirect Storage 的作用是？
o: Moves data from storage directly into GPU memory, bypassing a CPU staging copy
Replicates GPU memory to cloud storage
oZh: 把数据从存储直接搬进 GPU 显存，跳过 CPU 中转拷贝
questions.e: GDS provides a direct storage-to-GPU data path so dataloaders avoid extra CPU copies.
questions.eZh: GDS 提供存储到 GPU 的直通数据路径，dataloader 无需额外的 CPU 拷贝。

questions.q: Which traffic pattern dominates an AI training cluster network?
questions.qZh: AI 训练集群网络中占主导的流量模式是？
oZh: 东西向的 GPU 间同步流量（梯度/激活）
questions.e: Distributed training is GPU-to-GPU allreduce heavy, unlike traditional data centers dominated by client-server traffic.
questions.eZh: 分布式训练以 GPU 间 allreduce 为主，不同于传统数据中心以客户端-服务器流量为主。

questions.q: What is NCCL?
questions.qZh: NCCL 是什么？
o: NVIDIA's topology-aware library for collective communication across GPUs and nodes
oZh: NVIDIA 面向 GPU/多节点集合通信的拓扑感知通信库
questions.e: NCCL implements allreduce, broadcast, etc., detecting NVLink/PCIe/IB topology for near-peak collectives.
questions.eZh: NCCL 实现 allreduce、broadcast 等集合通信，自动感知 NVLink/PCIe/IB 拓扑以逼近峰值性能。

questions.q: What is DCGM used for?
questions.qZh: DCGM 用于做什么？
o: GPU monitoring, diagnostics, health checks and policy enforcement in the data center
oZh: 数据中心内 GPU 的监控、诊断、健康检查与策略管理
questions.e: Data Center GPU Manager provides telemetry, active health diagnostics and policy/alerting for GPU fleets.
questions.eZh: 数据中心 GPU 管理器（DCGM）为 GPU 集群提供遥测、主动健康诊断和策略告警。

questions.q: Which metrics does a typical DCGM monitoring field group include?
questions.qZh: 典型的 DCGM 监控指标组包含哪些指标？
o: Utilization, memory, temperature, power, ECC errors and NVLink status
oZh: 利用率、显存、温度、功耗、ECC 错误和 NVLink 状态
questions.e: DCGM-XPC exposes GPU util, memory, power, thermals, ECC and NVLink health as Prometheus-ready metrics.
questions.eZh: DCGM 导出 GPU 利用率、显存、功耗、温度、ECC 与 NVLink 健康等指标，可直接接入 Prometheus。

questions.q: What does the NVIDIA GPU Operator do in Kubernetes?
questions.qZh: NVIDIA GPU Operator 在 Kubernetes 中做什么？
o: Automates the deployment and lifecycle of GPU drivers, device plugins and monitoring
oZh: 自动化部署和管理 GPU 驱动、设备插件与监控组件的生命周期
为 Pod 编译 CUDA 代码
questions.e: The operator packages driver, device plugin, DCGM exporter and other components as managed Kubernetes resources.
questions.eZh: GPU Operator 把驱动、设备插件、DCGM exporter 等打包成可管理的 Kubernetes 资源并自动化其生命周期。

questions.q: Which workload type fits Slurm best?
questions.qZh: 哪类工作负载最适合用 Slurm？
o: Batch HPC jobs with partitions and queues
oZh: 带分区和队列的 HPC 批处理作业
长期运行的 Web 服务
questions.e: Slurm excels at batch scheduling of HPC/AI jobs; Kubernetes is preferred for services and stateful platforms.
questions.eZh: Slurm 擅长 HPC/AI 作业的批处理调度；服务和有状态平台更适合 Kubernetes。

questions.q: What is NVIDIA Base Command Manager?
questions.qZh: NVIDIA Base Command Manager 是什么？
o: Cluster management software for scheduling, monitoring and reporting across DGX fleets
oZh: 跨 DGX 集群做调度、监控和报告的集群管理软件
questions.e: Base Command Manager (formerly BCM) provides workload scheduling, monitoring and cluster provisioning for DGX environments.
questions.eZh: Base Command Manager（原 BCM）为 DGX 环境提供作业调度、监控与集群供给管理。

questions.q: In a multi-tenant cluster, what operational problem does MIG solve?
questions.qZh: 在多租户集群中，MIG 解决的运维问题是什么？
o: Multiple tenants safely share one physical GPU with isolation and fair allocation
oZh: 多个租户安全共享同一块物理 GPU，且相互隔离、分配公平
租户必须共用一个 CPU
questions.e: MIG partitions provide fault isolation and quality-of-service boundaries, letting one GPU serve several tenants.
questions.eZh: MIG 分区提供故障隔离与服务质量边界，让一块 GPU 能服务多个租户。

questions.q: What is a key consideration when virtualizing GPUs with vGPU?
questions.qZh: 用 vGPU 虚拟化 GPU 时需要注意什么？
o: Licensing and some performance overhead versus dedicated GPUs
vGPU removes the need for a driver
oZh: 需要许可授权，且相对独占 GPU 有一定性能开销
vGPU 只能用在笔记本上
questions.e: vGPU shares one GPU across VMs; plan licenses, profile sizes and accept an overhead versus passthrough.
questions.eZh: vGPU 让一块 GPU 被多台虚拟机共享；需规划许可证和配置规格，并接受相对直通的性能开销。

questions.q: Why must driver and CUDA versions be managed together?
questions.qZh: 为什么驱动与 CUDA 版本必须配套管理？
o: The driver determines the maximum supported CUDA runtime version
oZh: 驱动版本决定了可支持的 CUDA 运行时上限
questions.e: Each CUDA release pairs with a minimum driver; lifecycle planning (and compatible-driver packages) avoids breakage during upgrades.
questions.eZh: 每个 CUDA 版本都有最低驱动要求；生命周期规划与兼容驱动包可避免升级时出现故障。

questions.q: How does backfill scheduling improve cluster utilization?
questions.qZh: 回填（backfill）调度如何提高集群利用率？
o: Small jobs fill idle gaps behind large queued jobs without delaying them
It always runs jobs in alphabetical order
It forces all jobs to run at once
oZh: 让小作业利用大队列作业留下的空闲片段，且不推迟大作业
强制所有作业同时运行
questions.e: Backfill lets later jobs use nodes reserved-but-idle for a pending big job, raising overall utilization.
questions.eZh: 回填让后续小作业利用为等待中的大作业预留但暂时空闲的节点，从而提升整体利用率。

questions.q: GPUs in a training job show high CPU load but low GPU utilization. What is the most likely cause?
questions.qZh: 训练作业中 CPU 负载很高但 GPU 利用率很低，最可能的原因是？
o: A CPU-side data pipeline (preprocessing/IO) starving the GPU
oZh: CPU 侧数据管线（预处理/IO）喂不饱 GPU
questions.e: When the dataloader cannot keep up, GPUs idle waiting for batches; profile the data pipeline before blaming hardware.
questions.eZh: dataloader 跟不上时 GPU 只能空等数据；先分析数据管线，而不是先怀疑硬件。

questions.q: A GPU shows a rising trend of ECC errors. What is the recommended operational response?
questions.qZh: 某 GPU 的 ECC 错误呈上升趋势，建议的运维处置是？
o: Monitor closely and proactively plan replacement before hard failure
oZh: 密切监控并在硬故障前主动安排更换
无视直到 GPU 坏掉
questions.e: Increasing correctable ECC errors are a leading indicator of failing memory; trending them enables predictive maintenance.
questions.eZh: 可纠正 ECC 错误增多是显存故障的前兆；对趋势做监控可实现预测性维护。

questions.q: Before expanding an AI cluster, which facility items must be validated?
questions.qZh: 扩容 AI 集群前，必须先核实哪些设施条件？
o: Power, cooling, floor space, network ports and storage bandwidth
oZh: 供电、散热、地板空间、网络端口和存储带宽
questions.e: Capacity planning spans facility (power/cooling/space) and infrastructure (network ports, storage throughput), not just hardware purchase.
questions.eZh: 容量规划覆盖设施（供电/散热/空间）与基础设施（网络端口、存储吞吐），不只是买硬件。

questions.q: In Kubernetes, how does a pod request GPU resources?
questions.qZh: 在 Kubernetes 中，Pod 如何申请 GPU 资源？
o: Requesting nvidia.com/gpu in the pod's resource limits
Mounting the GPU as a volume by default
oZh: 在 Pod 的 resources.limits 中申请 nvidia.com/gpu
默认把 GPU 挂载为卷
使用 CPU 资源字段
无需申请，GPU 天然可见
questions.e: The NVIDIA device plugin exposes GPUs as the extended resource nvidia.com/gpu, which pods request in limits.
questions.eZh: NVIDIA 设备插件把 GPU 暴露为扩展资源 nvidia.com/gpu，Pod 在 limits 中按数量申请。
